mission.title: What is Sharyan?
mission.paragraphOne: Sharyan is a modern blood donation platform that bridges the gap between those who need blood and those willing to donate. We leverage technology to make blood donation faster, easier, and more efficient.
mission.paragraphTwo: Our name "Sharyan" (شريان) means "artery" in Arabic - the vital blood vessel that delivers life-giving blood throughout the body. Just like an artery, we deliver hope and life to those in need.
